summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a Form 6-K with a September 1, 2026 press release announcing a regular quarterly dividend of C$0.315313 per Series K Preferred Share, payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 14, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration by the issuer, not a special-situation event. No M&A, tender, restructuring, activist, or strategic action is involved. The only mechanical note is Canadian withholding tax for non-residents. This is a routine current report; no special-situation angle exists.
